items.title: Set up the homepage

items.title: Favicon

items.title: Browser compatibility
items.description: The site displays correctly in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Brave, and Edge.

items.title: Passwords saved
items.description: All site credentials are stored in the password management tool.

items.title: Client communication
items.description: The {{transferAgreement}} has been sent to the client.

items.title: Images, titles, and alt text
items.description: All images load correctly and have title and alt text where relevant.

items.title: Custom 404 page
items.description: A custom 404 page is in place to guide lost visitors back into the site.

items.title: No dummy content
items.description: All Lorem Ipsum, placeholder images, and unused pages or posts have been removed.

items.title: Social profiles configured
items.description: All social media profiles are correctly displayed and linked across the site.

items.title: Grammar and spelling report
items.description: A grammar and spelling audit has been run and the results saved to a spreadsheet.

items.title: Proofread audit reviewed
items.description: All spelling and grammar errors found in the audit have been fixed.

items.title: Clickable phone numbers
items.description: Every phone number on the site is a tap-to-call link.

items.title: No #! in dropdown menus
items.description: No menu link points to a dead '#' or '#!' anchor.

items.title: Navigation menu links

items.title: Internal links

items.title: Main phone number provided
items.description: The client has provided the main phone number to use across the site.

items.title: Phone number not hard-coded
items.description: The phone number is editable in one place (e.g. Theme Options) and updates site-wide, rather than being hard-coded per page.

items.title: Phone number consistency
items.description: The same, correct phone number is used consistently across the whole site.

items.title: Address easily editable
items.description: Physical addresses are editable in one place (Theme Options or header/footer) and update across the site.

items.title: Dynamic fields display correctly
items.description: Information pulled from a post's Custom Fields shows correctly and in the right place on every layout.

items.title: Layout holds with dynamic data
items.description: Sections using Custom Post Types or Custom Fields (testimonials, team members, etc.) keep their layout with content of any size.

items.title: Notification email provided
items.description: The client has provided the email address that form notifications should be sent to.

items.title: Contact forms configured
items.description: All forms have the right fields with correct names, IDs, and required settings.

items.title: Notification email delivered
items.description: Form submissions deliver a notification email to the correct address.

items.title: Form fields in notification email
items.description: The notification email lists all form fields and uses HTML content type.

items.title: Inline form validation
items.description: Forms validate in real time, flagging input errors before the user submits.

items.title: Form success message
items.description: A clear confirmation message appears after a successful form submission.

items.title: Mobile menu
items.description: The mobile menu looks correct — colors aren't inverted and the hamburger icon shows.

items.title: Mobile centering
items.description: Elements are centered on mobile wherever left alignment looks off.

items.title: Mobile navbar height
items.description: The mobile navbar is no taller than 82px.

items.title: Mobile nav menu
items.description: Make sure every navigation menu looks good on mobile. Use the styling from Sierra Health + Wellness as our standard for all sites, now and going forward.

items.title: Parent pages clickable on mobile
items.description: Parent menu items are reachable as links in the mobile dropdown, not just toggles.

items.title: Old integrations transferred
items.description: Every third-party integration from the old site (e.g. HubSpot) has been carried over.

items.title: Migrate 301 redirects
items.description: All existing 301 redirects have been exported from the old site and imported into the new one.

items.title: Keep the same URL structure
items.description: URLs meant to stay the same keep their original structure and slug.

items.title: Compare old and new URLs
items.description: All important URLs from the old site are present on the new site.

items.title: 301 redirects for changed URLs
items.description: Any URL that changed or was removed has a 301 redirect to its new location.

items.title: Migrate Yoast settings
items.description: Page and post titles, meta descriptions, and other Yoast settings carry over to the new site. https://wordpress.org/plugins/wordpress-seo/

items.title: Migrate header/footer codes
items.description: All still-relevant header and footer codes from the old site are copied to the new one.

items.title: Add Google Tag Manager
items.description: The Google Tag Manager container is added on staging for the AM to verify in the source.

items.title: Correct WordPress admin email
items.description: The site admin email is {{adminEmail}}, with a matching Administrator user added to the {{passwordStore}}.

items.title: Staging is not indexable
items.description: Search engine visibility is switched off while the site is in development.

items.title: Review plugins
items.description: Unused plugins are deleted and all remaining plugins are updated.

items.title: WP Engine Advanced Network
items.description: WP Engine's Advanced Network is enabled for better performance (requires WP Engine hosting and DNS access).

items.title: Migrated to WP Engine
items.description: The site is migrated to the correct ({{agencyName}}) WP Engine account.

items.title: Access to website backups
items.description: The site is backed up and previous backups are accessible on WP Engine.

items.title: Comments turned off
items.description: Comments are disabled site-wide to prevent spam, unless genuinely needed.

items.title: WordPress up to date
items.description: WordPress core is updated to the latest version.

items.title: Hide the login URL
items.description: The WPS Hide Login plugin is installed and the default admin URL is changed to backend-login to deter brute-force attacks. https://wordpress.org/plugins/wps-hide-login/

items.title: Install activity log plugin
items.description: The WP Activity Log plugin is installed. https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-security-audit-log/

items.title: Sticky header bar
items.description: The site has a sticky header on both desktop and mobile.

items.title: Sticky bottom bar
items.description: A bottom sticky bar is present with a properly styled phone number, e.g. (888) 888-8888.

items.title: Heroes fit on mobile
items.description: Hero sections show all their content correctly on a small screen (iPhone X).

items.title: Home not in navbar
items.description: The navigation menu does not include a 'Home' item.

items.title: Blog layout matches site
items.description: The Blog archive and Single Post templates match the overall site design.

items.title: Category layout matches site
items.description: Category archive pages match the overall site design.

items.title: Template hero from featured image
items.description: Template-based pages pull their hero/header image from the page's Featured Image.

items.title: Link colors on-brand and visible
items.description: Hyperlinks are a clearly different color from the body text (not the same dark/black) so they stand out — check inner/child pages too.

items.title: Permalinks optimized
items.description: Permalinks and URLs are clean and optimized for SEO.

items.title: Yoast SEO configured
items.description: Yoast is configured with a title separator and the site title set. https://wordpress.org/plugins/wordpress-seo/

items.title: Run a page speed audit
items.description: A speed and performance check has been run on the main pages.

items.title: Open Graph tags
items.description: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags are installed for rich link previews.

items.title: Nav menu has all key pages
items.description: The navigation menu links to all key pages so users can find what they need.

items.title: Consistent navigation
items.description: The navigation menu is identical across every page that has it.

items.title: Logo links to homepage
items.description: The header logo is a clickable link back to the homepage.

items.title: Two font families or fewer
items.description: The design uses no more than two font families.

items.title: Fonts legible in all styles
items.description: Fonts stay clear and legible in all forms — caps, italics, bold, etc.

items.title: Consistent font styles
items.description: Font styles and sizes are consistent across all pages.

items.title: Consistent branding
items.description: The brand's look, feel, colors, and messaging are consistent across the site.

items.title: Consistent layout
items.description: The layout is consistent across all pages for predictable, easy navigation.

items.title: Images fit the content
items.description: Images suit both the brand style and the content they accompany; note any mismatches.

items.title: Site title and tagline set
items.description: The site title and tagline are set.

items.title: Search page
items.description: Confirm whether the site has a search page.

items.title: Dummy data drafted
items.description: Anything containing dummy data is set to draft.

items.title: Rename default blog category
items.description: The default 'Uncategorized' blog category has been renamed.

items.title: Set real post authors
items.description: Posts are assigned to a real author, not the 'dev' user.

items.title: Point domain (A + CNAME)
items.description: The domain points to the host via both A and CNAME records.

items.title: Redirect www to root
items.description: The site consistently redirects www to root (or vice versa).

items.title: Google Analytics tags present
items.description: Google Analytics tags are present on the site (escalate if missing).

items.title: Correct CPTs indexed
items.description: Only the custom post types that should be indexed are indexed; others are excluded.

items.title: Remove placeholder blogs
items.description: Placeholder blog posts are deleted, not just drafted, before launch.

items.title: Color Contrast (WCAG 2.2)
items.description: All text must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA contrast ratios: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. The #1 accessibility failure — found on 83.9% of websites. SUCCESS: All text passes minimum ratios. FAIL: Any text fails — log page, element, colors, and actual ratio.

items.title: Keyboard Navigation
items.description: Verify entire site is navigable by keyboard only: Tab (forward), Shift+Tab (back), Enter/Space (activate), arrow keys (dropdowns). Every interactive element must be reachable without a mouse. SUCCESS: All elements reachable and operable. FAIL: Any element unreachable or creates keyboard trap — log page and element.

items.title: Focus Indicators Visible
items.description: A visible focus ring must appear on all interactive elements when navigated via keyboard. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 requires visible focus. Common failure: CSS sets outline:none globally. SUCCESS: Clear focus indicator on every element when tabbed to. FAIL: Focus invisible or removed on any element.

items.title: Heading Hierarchy
items.description: Each page must have exactly one H1, H2s for main sections, H3s for sub-sections. No skipped levels (H1 to H3 with no H2). Screen readers and SEO both depend on logical hierarchy. SUCCESS: One H1, sequential levels, no skipped levels. FAIL: Multiple H1s, skipped levels, or heading tags used for styling only.

items.title: Tap Target Size (WCAG 2.2)
items.description: All clickable elements must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels per WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. Apple/Google recommend 44x44px for good mobile usability. SUCCESS: All interactive elements meet 24x24px minimum. FAIL: Any element below 24x24px — log page and element.

items.title: Cookie Consent Banner
items.description: A consent mechanism must appear before any non-essential cookies fire. GDPR: opt-in required. CCPA/CPRA: opt-out required with Do Not Sell link. Banner must show Accept and Reject All with equal prominence. SUCCESS: Banner on first visit, cookies blocked before consent, Reject All available. FAIL: No banner, cookies fire before consent, or no Reject All.

items.title: Privacy Policy Page
items.description: A Privacy Policy page must exist, load without errors, and be linked in the footer of every page. Required by GDPR, CCPA, and Google policies. SUCCESS: Page exists, loads, and is linked in footer on all pages. FAIL: Missing page, broken link, or not accessible from all pages.

items.title: HTTP Security Headers
items.description: Server must return: (1) Strict-Transport-Security with max-age >= 63072000; (2) X-Frame-Options: DENY or CSP frame-ancestors; (3) X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; (4) Referrer-Policy. SUCCESS: All four headers present with correct values. FAIL: Any header missing — log which ones.

items.title: Core Web Vitals (All Sites)
items.description: Run CWV checks on ALL sites regardless of builder. 2026 thresholds: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1. Only 47% of sites pass all three. INP replaced FID in 2024 and is the most commonly failed. Use PageSpeed Insights on homepage and 2-3 key pages, desktop and mobile. SUCCESS: All three metrics in Good range. FAIL: Any metric fails — log scores and pages.

items.title: Schema Markup Validation
items.description: Validate all JSON-LD using Google Rich Results Test. Required types: LocalBusiness or MedicalBusiness (healthcare), BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, ContactPoint. Sites with valid schema are cited 3.2x more by AI engines in 2026. SUCCESS: All schema validates, correct types for site category. FAIL: Validation errors, missing required properties, or wrong schema type.

items.title: Flexbox container migration
items.description: Verify all sections use Flexbox containers (.e-con), not legacy sections or columns - legacy bloats DOM significantly.

items.title: DOM size audit
items.description: Count DOM nodes on key pages - target less than 1400 nodes. Elementor legacy sections add hundreds of wrapper divs.

items.title: Disable unused widgets
items.description: In Elementor > Settings > Elements, disable all widget categories not used on this site to reduce CSS and JS bundle size.

items.title: Improved asset loading on
items.description: Confirm Improved Asset Loading is enabled in Settings > Advanced - loads widget assets only on pages that use them.

items.title: Regenerate CSS and Data run
items.description: Run Tools > Regenerate CSS and Data after any theme or plugin update. Skipping this step causes broken layouts.

items.title: Google Fonts disabled if unused
items.description: If using custom or system fonts, disable Google Fonts in Elementor to eliminate external font requests.

items.title: WP memory limit 256M or more
items.description: Verify WP_MEMORY_LIMIT is at least 256M - Elementor requires it for editor stability.

items.title: PHP seven 7.4 or higher
items.description: Confirm PHP 7.4 is active (8.1 or higher recommended for Elementor Pro).

items.title: Pro license activated
items.description: Verify Elementor Pro license is active and valid for this specific domain.

items.title: Global colors and fonts used
items.description: Confirm all design uses Elementor Global Colors and Global Fonts - no hardcoded hex values in widget style tabs.

items.title: Pro form integrations tested
items.description: Submit a test entry through every Elementor Pro form - verify email delivery, CDM connections, and success messages.

items.title: Dynamic tags resolve
items.description: Verify all dynamic tags display correct content. No empty or fallback placeholder text visible on the frontend.

items.title: Mobile breakpoints reviewed
items.description: Review all widgets at all responsive breakpoints (375px and 768px) using DevTools responsive mode.

items.title: No animation CLS
items.description: Entrance animations must not cause Cumulative Layout Shift - run PageSpeed and check CLS score.

items.title: File permissions on CSS dir
items.description: Verify /wp-content/uploads/yootheme/ is writable (755 dir, 644 files) - wrong permissions means no CSS generated.

items.title: Custom CSS loads no 403
items.description: Confirm the generated YOOtheme CSS file loads with 200 OK - check DevTools > Network and filter by .css.

items.title: Plugin conflict check
items.description: Test for JS errors caused by plugin conflicts. YOOtheme relies on UIkit JS and conflicts silently break animations and modals.

items.title: UIkit components functional
items.description: Test all UIkit interactive elements: off-canvas menu, modals, dropdowns, sticky navbar, and sliders.

items.title: Less variables applied correctly
items.description: Verify custom colors and fonts from the theme customizer display correctly on the frontend.

items.title: UIkit icon font loads
items.description: Icons render correctly with no blank squares. Font file must load from the theme assets folder.

items.title: YOOtheme Pro license active
items.description: Verify the YOOtheme Pro license key is active and not expired in the theme settings.

items.title: Customizer CSS regenerated
items.description: After any theme changes, confirm CSS is freshly generated. Cached old CSS is a very common YOOtheme issue.

items.title: Child theme setup verified
items.description: If custom Less overrides exist, confirm the child theme is properly configured and active.

items.title: Multilingual switcher if WPML
items.description: If WPML or Polylang is used, test that the language switcher renders correctly in the YOOtheme navigation.

items.title: WooCommerce elements if used
items.description: Test all YOOtheme Pro WooCommerce builder elements: product grid, cart widget, and checkout flow.

items.title: Slider and gallery navigation
items.description: Test all sliders and galleries: autoplay, arrow navigation, dot indicators, and touch or swipe on mobile.

items.title: Sticky navbar behavior
items.description: Verify sticky header scrolls correctly without overlapping content or causing layout shifts.

items.title: Tailwind v4 build process
items.description: Verify package uses @tailwindcss/postcss and not old postcss-cli flags. Build pipeline must output correctly.

items.title: Content and purge paths complete
items.description: All template files PHP, Blade, Twig, JS are in Tailwind content detection. No utility classes purged on dynamic pages.

items.title: Production build runs clean
items.description: npm run build produces minified and purged CSS with no dev mode artifacts or hot reload code.

items.title: Preflight WP conflict check
items.description: Tailwind Preflight resets browser defaults - verify WP core elements admin bar and forms and comments are not broken.

items.title: CSS enqueue order correct
items.description: Tailwind CSS loads in the correct order relative to WordPress core styles - check enqueue priority in functions.php.

items.title: Safelist dynamic classes
items.description: Classes generated from ACF or PHP logic are added to the safelist in tailwind.config.js so they survive purge.

items.title: Apply directives compile
items.description: Custom component classes using @apply are present in the compiled CSS output - verify in built file.

items.title: Block editor compatibility
items.description: Gutenberg and FSE blocks render correctly in both the editor and frontend with Tailwind active.

items.title: No source maps in production
items.description: No dot map files exposed in production build - check Network tab for any map requests.

items.title: Build tool asset paths correct
items.description: If Vite is used, confirm production build outputs correct public asset paths with no localhost references in source.

items.title: Custom breakpoints match design
items.description: sm, md, lg, xl breakpoints in tailwind.config match the designer breakpoint specifications.

items.title: Typography and prose styles
items.description: Tailwindcss typography prose classes render correctly in posts, pages, and rich-text areas.

items.title: Production build is latest
items.description: Confirm the final production build ran immediately before go live. No dev mode CSS or stale compiled output.
